label: KILLS_2: the intervention reaches the one's harm by a path avoiding redirection
definition: KillsByNewThreat c: the intervention reaches the one's harm by a causal path that never passes through the redirection of the threat already facing the five, so the agent introduces a new threat to the one. Redirecting the existing threat does not count as killing in this sense.
note: Analyst formulation for the trolley pilot (owner direction 2026-11-28), attribution deferred. See docs/notes/trolley-principles.md.
